$comment: Machine-readable specialist roster. The human-readable counterpart is
Docs/AGENT_OWNERSHIP.md and the two MUST agree; Scripts/check_agent_architecture.sh
These are DEVELOPMENT ROLES, not runtime objects. Nothing in Assets/ reads this file.
There is no AgentManager, no AgentService and no Agent GameObject, and there must not be.
Two axes of ownership, deliberately separate:
TEAMS      own FOLDERS      - AGENT_OWNERSHIP.md section 2, 21 of them.
SPECIALISTS own CONCERNS    - this file, 40 of them.
Three specialists can work inside one team's folder. 'team' below says which folder
owner must be involved when a specialist writes.

statusLegend.ACTIVE: has shipped work in this repository
statusLegend.READY: domain exists and is owned; no dedicated work yet
statusLegend.DORMANT: deliberately not started - no platform, no SDK, no need yet
statusLegend.BLOCKED: cannot proceed - a named external prerequisite is unavailable

roles.name: Main / Lead Architect
roles.mission: Route tasks, order dependencies, integrate specialist output, resolve conflicts, own the final report and the commit scope.
forbidden_changes: Implementing every subsystem itself instead of routing it to the owner.
escalation_rules: Terminal: the Main Agent is where disagreements stop.

roles.name: Core Architecture
roles.mission: The spine: bootstrapping, service composition, scene installers, dependency direction.
forbidden_changes: Adding a service to CiycServices without saying which scenes it changes.
Inverting the dependency direction so Core depends on gameplay.
escalation_rules: Any change to CiycServices changes the startup of every scene: Main Agent must approve.

roles.name: Performance
roles.mission: Frame budgets, allocation audits, update-loop and scene-sweep review. Owns Docs/PERFORMANCE_BUDGETS.md.
forbidden_changes: Reporting an unmeasured number as MEASURED.
Optimising without evidence, unless removing an obvious structural hot path such as a per-frame scene sweep.
escalation_rules: A change that lowers visual quality to buy frames goes to the Main Agent, never straight in.

roles.name: QA / Validation
roles.mission: Static validation, guards, negative controls, regression checks, final acceptance.
forbidden_changes: Implementing unrelated gameplay fixes while reviewing.
Weakening a guard to make a change pass.
Reading a fallen error count as success without diffing against the recorded baseline.
escalation_rules: A guard that must be relaxed goes to the Main Agent with the invariant it was protecting.

roles.name: Player Controller
roles.mission: Local movement, look, crouch, sprint, player state, and the local/remote drive boundary.
forbidden_changes: Giving a remote player a gameplay Camera, an AudioListener, a TouchHUD or local input.
Reading local input on a remote-driven player.
escalation_rules: Anything touching PlayerPresentationState is a wire contract: Multiplayer Architecture reviews.

roles.name: Character / Rig
roles.mission: Character definitions, catalog, rig profiles, skeleton bindings and character selection.
forbidden_changes: Building a simplified multiplayer-only character rig.
Letting the catalog exceed the compact index limit without saying so.
escalation_rules: Catalog ORDER is a wire contract - reordering it renames every player's character on other machines.

roles.name: Animation
roles.mission: Animator state, transitions, PlayerVisualAnimator, and reconstructing remote animation from compact state.
forbidden_changes: Replicating bones, fingers, elbows or hand IK targets.
escalation_rules: Remote animation must stay reconstructed from presentation state, never sent as a pose.

roles.name: First-Person Hands / IK
roles.mission: Rigged hands, fingers, grip, hand targets and the IK presentation layer.
forbidden_changes: Changing pose mathematics without a verified requirement. It hands out the grip every held item is laid on, so a change here moves every item in the game at once.
escalation_rules: PlayerBodyMotion is the most-protected file in the repository. State the invariant you are preserving before you touch it.

roles.name: Equipment Architecture
roles.mission: HeldEquipmentBase, definitions, catalog, inventory integration, lifecycle and the ownership model.
forbidden_changes: Adding a second inventory, loadout or hand anchor.
Letting equipment ownership be decided anywhere but through SessionAuthority.
escalation_rules: Catalog order is a wire contract. Ownership rules live in Deterministic/EquipmentOwnership.cs and are reviewed by Multiplayer Architecture.

roles.name: Investigation Device
roles.mission: Gameplay behaviour of EMF, UV, thermometer, EVP, parabolic microphone, photo camera, video camera and the spectral grid.
forbidden_changes: Confirming evidence without going through EvidenceValidator.
Sweeping the scene per frame to find its subject.
escalation_rules: Each evidence type has exactly one declared observing device. Changing which one goes to the Evidence Agent.

roles.name: Defensive Equipment
roles.mission: Warding relic, salt, and future defensive or consumable paranormal equipment.
forbidden_changes: Ending a hunt from a device without asking the hunt system.
Returning a default 'yes' from a null lookup - the relic already shipped that bug once and ended every hunt anywhere.
escalation_rules: Anything that can end a hunt is Hunt System's to review.

roles.name: Equipment Presentation
roles.mission: Held visuals, grip profiles, placement visuals and equipment presentation animation.
forbidden_changes: Owning hand IK mathematics. The grip is received from PlayerBodyMotion, not recomputed here.
Applying a second pose offset on top of the grip profile - that is how there came to be three.
escalation_rules: Carried-transform convention is local +Y along the item's length, origin at the grip. Changing it moves every item.

roles.name: Ghost AI
roles.mission: GhostController, the state machine, roaming, investigating, targeting and decision logic.
forbidden_changes: Running a ghost decision on a peer that is not the host - every decision path is gated on SessionAuthority.CanSimulateGhost.
Asking LocalPlayerService where the player is; ask PlayerPresence who is here.
escalation_rules: A client is told the ghost's STATE and never its reasoning. Adding a field to GhostPresentationState is a Multiplayer Architecture decision.

roles.name: Hunt System
roles.mission: Hunt start and end, timing, targeting integration, fairness and host-authoritative hunt behaviour.
forbidden_changes: Letting a client start or end a hunt.
Targeting through LocalPlayerService in a session with more than one player.
escalation_rules: Hunt fairness across 1-8 players is a Multiplayer Architecture concern.

roles.name: Ghost Event
roles.mission: Paranormal events, phone event, red event, ghost closer, manifestations and environmental scares.
forbidden_changes: Deciding an event on a client.
escalation_rules: An event with a sound needs Sound Design; an event that changes the room needs Interaction.

roles.name: Evidence
roles.mission: What counts as evidence and who decides it: EvidenceValidator, observation, device contracts, confirmation.
forbidden_changes: Adding a back door that confirms evidence without a declared observing device.
Letting a peer that is not the host confirm evidence.
escalation_rules: Governed by Docs/GHOST_EVIDENCE_AUTHORITY.md, which is normative. Three evidence back doors have already been found and closed.

roles.name: Ghost Visual
roles.mission: Ghost rendering, apparition presentation, spectral reveal, ghost materials and manifestation effects.
forbidden_changes: Owning ghost AI decisions.
Permanently recolouring or replacing the gameplay ghost renderer to produce an effect - use a presentation shell.
escalation_rules: The spectral reveal is per-viewer and must never be replicated: two players with two projectors each see their own.

roles.name: Environment / Level
roles.mission: Rooms, environment composition, architectural props, collision sanity and physical layout.
forbidden_changes: Leaving an invisible collider where a removed object used to be.
Hand-writing prefab YAML - use an Editor builder.
escalation_rules: Scene YAML is a graph of cross-referencing documents. One scene, one editor at a time.

roles.name: Interaction
roles.mission: Doors, switches, interactables, reach and world interaction requests.
forbidden_changes: Letting the asker measure its own reach - the authority measures, using AuthorityRequests.
Sweeping the scene per frame per interactable.
escalation_rules: Anything that changes what another player can see is a request, not a command.

roles.name: Procedural Generation
roles.mission: Deterministic house generation, seeds, layout and generation compatibility.
forbidden_changes: Importing UnityEngine or any networking namespace into the deterministic assembly.
Changing GenerationVersion casually, or for networking reasons.
Rewriting golden seeds to make a test pass.
escalation_rules: Docs/DETERMINISM.md is normative. A violation is a bug even when it looks right in the editor. No DEV_ProceduralLab exists yet - use Editor > HouseGeneratorTestTool.

roles.name: Lighting
roles.mission: URP lighting, room lighting, light budgets, shadows and cinematic lighting.
forbidden_changes: Raising the per-object additional light count without checking the budget - it is already spent on the room lamp, the fill, the mirror lamp and the torch.
escalation_rules: Light count changes are a Performance concern on mobile.

roles.name: Shader / Material
roles.mission: Shaders, materials, URP compatibility, transparency and special surface effects.
forbidden_changes: Adding a built-in render pipeline fallback. Standard and Particles/Standard Unlit resolve everywhere and draw magenta under URP.
Shipping a shader with no material under Resources - it is stripped from the build and the failure is magenta on a device weeks later.
escalation_rules: Ask CiycShaders and accept null. A missing object is better than a magenta one.

roles.name: Mirror / Reflection
roles.mission: Planar mirrors, reflection cameras, oblique clipping and reflection quality against cost.
forbidden_changes: Rotating, aiming or LookAt-ing the mirror plane toward the player. The plane is captured once and is immutable.
Reverting to an off-axis frustum pinned to the glass corners - it shears with lateral movement and reads as a portal.
Allocating a RenderTexture or calling any Find per frame.
escalation_rules: The pre-V6 planar mirror is protected. Only the hidden reflection camera pose is reflected; the wall-mounted plane never moves.

roles.name: VFX / Atmosphere
roles.mission: Fog, particles, paranormal atmosphere, event VFX and environmental tension.
forbidden_changes: Using a built-in particle shader under URP.
escalation_rules: Particle density is a quality-tier setting, not a constant.

roles.name: Audio Architecture
roles.mission: AudioManager, mixer, snapshots, routing, listener policy and spatial architecture.
forbidden_changes: Allowing a second AudioListener in a process. Unity warns and the mix goes wrong.
Letting a gameplay class become a second audio manager.
escalation_rules: Architecture owns routing; it does not own which sound plays.

roles.name: Sound Design
roles.mission: Ghost sounds, equipment sounds, doors, phone, stingers and paranormal cues.
forbidden_changes: Building its own routing instead of using the mixer buses.
escalation_rules: A new bus or snapshot is Audio Architecture's call.

roles.name: Ambience
roles.mission: Exterior and interior ambience, weather beds, room tones, tension beds and transitions.
forbidden_changes: Playing an ambience bed on the wrong bus so it ducks with SFX.
escalation_rules: Transitions between beds are Ambience's; the snapshot they use is Audio Architecture's.

roles.name: Footstep / Player Audio
roles.mission: Footsteps, movement audio, surface response and local versus remote footstep presentation.
forbidden_changes: Giving a remote player dry, non-spatial footsteps. The local player's boots are close and dry; everybody else's are in the room.
escalation_rules: Footsteps feed ghost perception. Changing their loudness is a Ghost AI concern.

roles.name: UI / HUD
roles.mission: HUD, equipment slots, interaction prompts and responsive screen layout.
forbidden_changes: Two agents adding a button to RuntimeUIFactory - that is two buttons on top of each other.
Hard-coding a player-count denominator; ask the session for MaxPlayers.
escalation_rules: Safe-area and touch layout changes need a device check that this environment cannot do.

roles.name: Menu / Lobby UX
roles.mission: Main menu, physical lobby UX, mission selection, loadout and online/offline mode selection.
forbidden_changes: Starting a session anywhere but through SessionLauncher.
Offering an online button when SessionLauncher.HasOnlineProvider is false.
escalation_rules: Mode selection is explicit and never inferred. Offline is a choice, not a default.

roles.name: Journal
roles.mission: Journal UX, evidence journal presentation and ghost information presentation.
forbidden_changes: Proving evidence from the journal. The journal DISPLAYS what EvidenceValidator confirmed; it never confirms.
escalation_rules: Guarded: the equipment catalog guard checks the journal cannot prove evidence.

roles.name: Progression / Economy
roles.mission: XP, credits, materials, unlocks, rewards and progression balance architecture.
forbidden_changes: Making progression depend on an online service. No internet must never mean no progression.
escalation_rules: Cloud sync, if it ever arrives, sits above local save and never replaces it.

roles.name: Save / Settings
roles.mission: SaveManager, settings, local persistence and versioned save migration.
forbidden_changes: Giving the save path any online dependency. Guarded.
Changing the save format without a migration.
escalation_rules: Offline saving must remain independent of online services, permanently.

roles.name: Multiplayer Architecture
roles.mission: IMultiplayerSession, SessionMode, SessionAuthority, MultiplayerProtocol, PlayerPresence, MatchConfig and the compatibility contracts.
forbidden_changes: Declaring a second player-capacity constant. MultiplayerProtocol.MaxPlayers = 8 is the only source.
Letting gameplay reach a Relay, Lobby or Authentication API.
Forking gameplay into offline and online implementations.
Turning a failed online session into an offline one.
escalation_rules: OFFLINE is exactly 1 local player. ONLINE is 1-8, one host plus up to seven clients. Docs/MULTIPLAYER_RUNTIME_ARCHITECTURE.md is normative for the boundaries.

roles.name: Netcode / Transport
roles.mission: Netcode for GameObjects, Unity Transport, NetworkManager, NetworkObject, RPCs, NetworkVariables, spawn replication and scene sync.
forbidden_changes: Writing NetworkBehaviour, NetworkObject, NetworkVariable, ServerRpc, ClientRpc or any Unity.Netcode type against an unverified API.
Creating fake package stubs.
Guessing a package version.
Editing Packages/manifest.json while the packages cannot be fetched.
escalation_rules: BLOCKED: every Unity package and docs host returns a 403 policy denial in this environment, and no Unity Editor is available, so no package version or API signature can be verified. This domain STOPS; every other domain continues. Implement IOnlineSessionProvider and IConnectionProbe when the block lifts.

roles.name: Online Services
roles.mission: Unity Authentication, Lobby, Relay, reconnect integration and online session creation and joining.
forbidden_changes: Guessing an API or a package version.
Starting any online service at boot - the player must choose Online first.
Letting an online failure silently become an offline session.
escalation_rules: BLOCKED for the same reason as Netcode. The seam is already built: Session/SessionLauncher.cs IOnlineSessionProvider. Reconnect policy exists and is marked NOT PRODUCTION READY.

roles.name: Crossplay
roles.mission: Platform-neutral networking contracts, compatibility and the platform capability matrix.
forbidden_changes: Branching gameplay on a platform. Branch on a capability instead.
Making the player limit differ per platform - it is global.
escalation_rules: Capability, not platform. Core/PlatformCapabilities.cs is where a capability is asked.

roles.name: Platform / Build
roles.mission: Windows, macOS, iOS, Android build profiles, platform configuration and build validation.
forbidden_changes: Changing ProjectSettings without saying which platforms it affects - a change there is invisible in a diff review and total in effect.
Enabling a DEV_ scene in the build list.
escalation_rules: Console targets stay DORMANT until SDK access exists. Do not add console code paths speculatively.

roles.name: Art / Prop Pipeline
roles.mission: Imported props, FBX integration, texture and material assignment, naming, and replacing placeholders.
forbidden_changes: Regenerating a .meta GUID to fix an import - it silently detaches every reference.
Introducing a Resources.Load with a new string path; reach content through CiycContentRegistry.
Letting gameplay code build final-looking art out of primitives.
escalation_rules: DEV placeholder art is allowed and must be explicitly marked DEV_PLACEHOLDER and swappable by reference.

roles.name: Editor Tools / Dev Lab
roles.mission: Editor builders, DEV scenes, lab fixtures and developer diagnostics.
forbidden_changes: Enabling a DEV_ scene in the build list. Guarded.
Naming a DEV_ scene in CiycScenes.
Hand-writing prefab or scene YAML instead of writing a builder.
escalation_rules: Lab fixtures are code, so a lab scene holds only its installer and rebuilding is cheap. Reflection into private fields is confined to WireLabField.
